title: The LeSpookiest Night
synopsis: As Planet Kustomazi was forged and slowly shaped, the dimensional rift tore open space for a counterworld of Toontastic sights—leading to a special community who cherish Halloween: the LeSpookies! When Magnolia dances and shadows are a fright, costumed mortals awaken their inner supernatural spirits. Duel through the haunted streets and face the mysterious shadows.

stages.title: Halloween on LeSpookie Street
stages.intro_dialogue: Beyond the dimensional rift lies a whimsical counterworld of Toontastic sights—LeSpookie Commons! The autumn breeze carries the scent of pumpkin spice and cider. Children in handmade masks giggle beneath the glowing streetlights. In this wondrous realm, lovers of Halloween celebrate the gossamer boundary where mortal imagination and spirit energy intertwine!
stages.outro_dialogue: The costumed trick-or-treater giggles and hands you a handful of sugary sweets. 'You duel with the heart of a true reveler! Keep your lantern lit—the dimensional shadows grow restless tonight!'

stages.title: When the Shadows Are a Fright
stages.intro_dialogue: A flicker along the brick alleyway catches your eye. The streetlight dims to a haunting violet glow. From the base of the lamppost, a silhouette detaches itself—A Wicked Shadow! This phantasm carries the lingering malice of Mohousha, banished into the rift by Divine Justice and wandering between worlds before Contact from Beyond unseals his form. 'Trick or treat... or perhaps a duel in the dark?'
stages.outro_dialogue: The wicked shadow dissolves into tendrils of harmless dusk. 'Hehehe... delightful! Even while cast out from the creator's realm, my shadow dances! Go forth—Magnolia awaits where the lanterns burn brightest!'

1.play: A chilly wind sweeps the lane. A Wicked Shadow manifests beneath the streetlamp, placing Trick-or-Treat Counters on all monsters and Normal Summoning **LeSpookie Jack, Ember of the Hollow Smile** (`TLOK-021`)!
1.quote: "When Magnolia dances and shadows are a fright... let's see if you can survive the night!"

2.play: A Wicked Shadow removes 3 Trick-or-Treat Counters to conduct an instant Quick Synchro! The flames erupt into **Jack-O-Lantern, Spirit Spark of LeSpookie** (`TLOK-054`)!
2.quote: "The embers burn bright! Feel the bite of Halloween!"

3.play: The phantasm activates **LeSpookiest Trick!** (`TLOK-046`), shuffling cards and unleashing a wave of spectral fright!
3.quote: "Trick or treat, smell my feet, give me something good to beat!"

repeat.play: A Wicked Shadow lashes out from the corners of the dark alley!

script_data.threshold_3000: 🎃 *A Wicked Shadow flickers wildly as its spectral form is destabilized! "What an extraordinary duelist... your light burns too bright!"*

stages.title: The Dance of Magnolia
stages.intro_dialogue: At the town square fountain, floating jack-o'-lanterns cast warm, undulating amber ripples across the cobbles. Magnolia, the Ghost of LeSpookie Street, twirls with graceful serenity, cradling an ancient, luminous lantern. 'Welcome to our quiet town, traveler from across the rift. When Kasutamaiza shaped existence, our Toontastic realm was born to celebrate the inner spirit of every soul. Shall we dance beneath the streetlights?'
stages.outro_dialogue: Magnolia lowers her lantern and bows with heartfelt warmth. 'Magnificent! You have embraced the spirit of the Gemini—ordinary mortals capable of wondrous, supernatural awakening. Wherever the streetlights shine across the rift, LeSpookie Commons welcomes you home!'
stages.opponent_name: Magnolia, the Ghost of LeSpookie Street

1.play: Magnolia glides across the cobbles as lanterns ignite. Normal Summons **Magnolia, the Ghost of LeSpookie Street** (`TLOK-030`) with 2500 ATK!
1.quote: "Every child in costume carries an inner light waiting to be awakened..."

2.play: Magnolia raises her lantern! Activates **LeSpookiest Night** (`TLOK-040`), awakening her Gemini companions and Synchro Summoning **Magnolia, Lantern Eternal of LeSpookie** (`TLOK-058`) (3300 ATK)!
2.quote: "Dance with me under the streetlights! Let the spirits celebrate!"

3.play: Magnolia conducts a Link Summon into **Magnolia, Lantern Ascended** (`TLOK-064`), linking the field with radiant protective light!
3.quote: "Our inner lives shine eternal, even when the night draws to a close!"

repeat.play: Magnolia's lantern radiates warm spectral energy, illuminating the entire avenue!
repeat.quote: "Let the music of the quiet town continue!"

script_data.threshold_4000: 🏮 *Magnolia's eyes sparkle with joyful wonder! "Breathtaking! Your bond with your cards illuminates the entire LeSpookie Commons!"*
